CustomField.inlineHelpText: This category emphasizes ethical and safe communication. It focuses on producing respectful and responsible content, ensuring truthfulness, and avoiding any offensive or misleading information. It also prioritizes protecting individuals from physical, psychological, or informational harm. These guidelines advocate for dignified, conscientious communication, blending ethical principles with a commitment to safety and security in all interactions.
CustomField.label: Grounding - Ethical
